subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the SAME adult woman shown in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. These are two views of one person, not two characters. Preserve her shoulder-length chestnut loose wavy hair, hazel eyes, facial structure and natural skin texture. She wears the ivory silk open-collar blouse with sleeves rolled to her forearms, high-waisted warm taupe wide-leg tailored trousers, slim dark brown belt, dark brown leather loafers and small gold hoop earrings from <Picture 1>. <Picture 2> supplies a closer complementary view of her face and the same blouse and gold hoop earrings.
<Environment 1> is the quiet European cafe terrace in <Picture 3>: warm limestone walls, dark green window frames, climbing greenery, cobblestone lane, round wooden table, wooden chair and a small cream ceramic coffee cup on its saucer. Use this location and warm late-afternoon light, not the studio background of the character references.

summary:
[reference generation] A 10-second photorealistic cinematic coffee-break scene featuring exactly one woman, <Subject 1>, in <Environment 1>. Consistent identity, clothing, cup and location throughout.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1, 0-4 seconds] A medium three-quarter shot of <Subject 1> already seated at the cafe table, relaxed, both feet on the ground. She glances at the cream cup, then naturally lifts it by its handle with her right hand. The saucer stays on the table. Warm sunlight catches her ivory silk blouse and chestnut waves. Very slow gentle camera push-in.
[Shot 2, 4-7 seconds] Cut to a closer view of the SAME woman and SAME outfit. She takes one small sip, pauses, and gently lowers the cup. Realistic hand anatomy and contact with the cup, subtle breathing, natural blinking.
[Shot 3, 7-10 seconds] Return to a medium view. She places the cup back on the same saucer, turns her head slightly toward the quiet cobblestone lane and smiles softly. Preserve spatial continuity and the golden-hour lighting.

overall_soundscape:
Soft outdoor breeze, distant birds and one gentle ceramic cup clink. No speech, no narration, no music, no subtitles. No additional people, no identity changes, no wardrobe changes, no split screens, no collages.
